chains.trait: Disembodied skin-muscle filter mats with retained eyes
links: Qu waste streams provide constant organic slurry
Dormant nanites enable rapid tissue turnover and metal chelation
Punishment mandates conscious witness via retained vision
Asexual and sexual reproduction maximizes colonization speed

skill.effect: Neutralizes environmental toxins and nanite decay radiation, granting damage reduction (40% for 60s).

chains.weakness: Physically fragile; limited mobility makes them easy targets for kinetic attacks.
observe: Quilt-like fields of human flesh stretching to horizons
Weeping eyes embedded in muscle tissue
Shimmering nanite dust settling on shorelines

journal.en: They learned to eat poison and keep their eyes open. A mercy the Qu denied them, and a curse that outlived the Qu.

plausibility.summary: Frame as Qu punitive somatic engineering, not natural selection; survival via filter-feeding on waste slurry is plausible, but conscious witnessing eyes are a designed constraint—gameplay ‘witness’ mechanic, not an adaptive optimum.
fixes: Frame as Qu punitive somatic engineering, not natural selection; survival via filter-feeding on waste slurry is plausible, but conscious witnessing eyes are a designed constraint—gameplay ‘witness’ mechanic, not an adaptive optimum.

analogues.organism: Marine filter mats/sponges (choanocyte channels); freshwater sponge gemmules; no Earth analogue for distributed conscious epidermis
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Living filter mats and nervous-net cultures
links: High-pressure brine pools demand passive nutrient extraction
1.8 bar atmosphere with geothermal metal runoff suspends particulates
Dense air triples acoustic impedance, favoring ground vibration sensing
Hemocyanin-like oxygen transport systems selected for copper-rich aquatic/soil chemistry

skill.effect: Converts contaminated soil/water into temporary stamina and reduces radiation damage by 30%.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to rapid desiccation when atmospheric humidity drops below 40%.

journal.en: They don't walk. They spread. Forty million years of witnessing taught them patience, not legs.

plausibility.summary: Tie hemocyanin benefit to brine/vent margins (F9,F11), not generic 1.8 bar air; desiccation weakness fits intertidal mat analogues—keep them shore/waste-bound, not continent-spanning mobile organisms.
